DR STEVENS HERBS · HERB SAFETY

Your wellbeing comes first.

Information to help you make a clear, informed choice.

Ask Dr Stevens directly

Message Dr Stevens on WhatsApp or call +1 (848) 448-7130. He will talk through the product, ingredients, use and suitability for your situation.

Your guidance point

Use this page as a conversation prompt, not a substitute for Dr Stevens. Tell him what you use, what you want to know and what you are considering.

Call or WhatsApp

Call +1 (848) 448-7130 or use the WhatsApp link to discuss the herb, the product label and your circumstances with Dr Stevens.

If you want a clearer answer

Contact Dr Stevens directly before you decide. If a product feels uncertain, message him and ask for the exact details, how to use it and what to consider in your situation.

Help and next step

If you are unsure, contact Dr Stevens with your question. He will guide the conversation and help you decide the next step.
